newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Jews arrested at Jerusalem's al-Aqsa mosque.
newsitem.headline: Jews arrested at Jerusalem's al-Aqsa mosque.

text.p: Israeli police said on Wednesday they had detained for questioning seven ultra-nationalist Jews who tried to force their way into Jerusalem's al-Aqsa mosque complex.
Police spokesman Shmulik Ben-Ruby said the seven belonged to the Hai Vekayam group, which regularly tries to get into the compound, in antiquity the site of the Jewish temples, to pray.

Jewish and other tourists are allowed onto the site, also known as Temple Mount, but police forbid Jewish prayers or demonstrations there as a provocation to Moslems. Jews traditionally pray at the adjacent Wailing Wall.

The site is sensitive in the extreme. Palestinian anger when Israel opened a second entrance to an ancient tunnel passing near the complex sparked clashes in the West Bank and Gaza Strip last month in which 59 Palestinians and 15 Israelis were killed.
